resolved_samples.reasoning: The codes 1 (self-report), 4 (clinician-administered structured interview), and 7 (clinician-rated scale) were identified from multiple candidates explicitly naming instruments. Self-report (1) was supported by the Beck Depression Inventory (BDI) and Social Adjustment Scale—Self-Report (SAS-SR). Clinician-administered structured interview (4) was supported by the Schedule for Affective Disorders and Schizophrenia for School-aged Children (K-SADS). Clinician-rated scale (7) was supported by the Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (HAMD), Children's Global Assessment Scale (C-GAS), and Clinical Global Impressions scale (CGI). All candidates that named specific instruments contributing to these codes were included. Candidates 4 and 8 were excluded as their evidence did not explicitly name a measurement instrument.
